items.title: Mozambique: State Procurement Centre does not eliminate or replace UGEAs, Government clarifies
items.summary: The Ministry of Finance clarified on Wednesday, 23 September, that the State Procurement Centre (Central de Aquisições do Estado, CAE), recently established by Decree No. 22/2026 of 8 June as part of the reform of public procurement, will not replace, let alone eliminate, the Procurement Management and Execution Units (Unidades Gestoras e Executoras de Aquisições,… Source
items.why: The “Mozambique: State Procurement Centre does not eliminate or replace UGEAs, Government clarifies” opportunity has a responsible entity, a concrete action and a deadline that should be checked before applying.
items.action: Open the original notice for “Mozambique: State Procurement Centre does not eliminate or replace UGEAs, Government clarifies”, confirm the requirements and deadline, and prepare the requested documents.

note: Editorial radar: opportunities with an identified deadline remain visible until that date; notices without a deadline remain visible for 14 days only.
